Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

r4np 1.2.1

  • install_r4np() has been redesigned:
    • It now installs only packages that are missing and updates those that are out of date; packages that are already up to date are skipped. Running it again is quick and brings all packages up to date.
    • It uses pak to install packages, installing pak first if needed, and falls back to install.packages() if pak is unavailable or fails.
    • It no longer fails on Linux (it previously always used type = "both", which only works on Windows and macOS).
    • It no longer installs the suggested packages of every package (dependencies = TRUE), which added hundreds of unneeded packages.
    • It respects the CRAN repository set in your R options instead of always using cloud.r-project.org.
    • It reports which packages were installed, updated, already up to date or could not be installed, instead of always reporting success.
    • The help page now lists all packages from the same source as the code, so the two cannot get out of sync.
  • install_r4np() now installs ggmosaic2 for mosaic plots, matching the book. It replaces ggmosaic, which was archived on CRAN.

r4np 1.2.0

  • New vtest() runs Levene’s test for homogeneity of variance on several variables at once and returns the results as a tidy tibble. It mirrors ntest(): variables are chosen with cols, groups with group (several grouping variables are combined, e.g. for a two-way ANOVA), and inputs are checked with clear error messages. The default center = "median" matches car::leveneTest(); center = "mean" gives the original Levene’s test. The computation uses only stats, so car is not required.

  • install_r4np() now also installs learnr and gradethis, which the interactive exercises need. gradethis is installed from r-universe; if that fails, the other packages stay installed and a message shows how to install it manually. The function now uses cli messages and returns the installed package names invisibly.

  • Removed ggmosaic from install_r4np() and Suggests, as it was archived on CRAN (2025-11-10) and broke R CMD check.

  • gradethis (used in the tutorials) is now found via Additional_repositories (r-universe) instead of the non-CRAN Remotes field.

  • Updated CITATION to use bibentry() and dataset sources to use \doi{}.

  • Updated the GitHub Actions R-CMD-check workflow to the current r-lib standard (the retired ubuntu-20.04 runner left Linux checks queued forever).

r4np 1.1.0

Breaking changes

  • The first column of the ntest() output is now called variable instead of row_name, consistent with ntest_by().

Improvements

  • ntest_by() now gives the same clear error messages as ntest() for invalid input, counts sample sizes per variable ignoring missing values, rejects variables that are constant within a group, never tests the grouping variable itself, and ignores any existing grouping of df (with a short hint if it differs from group).
  • Documentation of cols and group in ntest() and ntest_by() now explains that they take unquoted column names and tidyselect helpers, and that df can be piped in. Examples no longer use \dontrun{}.
  • ntest() now ungroups grouped data frames before testing, so grouping variables are no longer tested by mistake. A hint suggests ntest_by() for per-group tests.
  • ntest() now checks its inputs before testing and gives clear error messages when df is not a dataframe, cols is missing or selects no variables, variables are not numeric, sample sizes are out of range, or a variable is constant.
  • ntest() and ntest_by() no longer use .data inside tidyselect expressions, which was deprecated in tidyselect 1.2.0.
  • ntest() and ntest_by() now import shapiro.test() from stats explicitly (fixes an R CMD check NOTE).
  • Documentation is now generated with roxygen2 8.1.0 and markdown enabled, so code formatting and links in all help pages render correctly.

r4np 1.0.1

  • Added NEWS.md to track package changes.

r4np 1.0.0

  • Finished exercises for all chapters and bundled them with the package.
  • Added the infer package to install_r4np() to support inference examples.
  • Polished dataset descriptions for the final release.

r4np 0.9.0

  • Revised dataset descriptions for clarity.
  • Added the author’s ORCID to package metadata.

r4np 0.8.1

  • Introduced blank exercise templates for future chapters.

r4np 0.8.0

  • First public beta release with extensive data documentation updates.

r4np 0.0.2

  • Added new wvs dataset containing a subset of the World Values Survey.
  • Expanded documentation and examples for helper functions.
  • Included CITATION file and enabled R CMD check support.

r4np 0.0.1

  • Initial release of the r4np companion package.
  • Provided install_r4np() to install companion resources.
  • Introduced create_dr() helper to scaffold project folders.
  • Shipped with imdb_top_250 sample data for exercises.
